summary: Sabesp filed a Form 6-K disclosing that its Board of Directors approved crediting interest on equity (Brazilian tax-advantaged shareholder remuneration, a JCP distribution with no direct US equivalent) totaling R$2,636,971,532.99 gross, equal to 50% of nine-month 2026 net profit after a 5% legal reserve. The per-share amount is R$0.75197707687 per common share, excluding treasury shares, with record date November 10, 2026 and ex-interest trading on B3 from November 11, 2026. The credit offsets mandatory 2026 dividends and carries no monetary adjustment; payment timing ties to the 2026 AGM. Watch the cash-flow and dividend-equivalence implications.
